_doc: Phase dependency DAG derived from PRISM-MASTER-ROADMAP-v1.md. Edges: predecessor -> successor (must be merged before successor can claim). Used by helpers/dependency-graph-checker.mjs.

_collision_notes.P1.1+P1.2+P1.3: All three sub-phases share prism-router-ms0 worktree. SEQUENTIAL within worktree (one chat owns all three) OR fork to sibling worktrees if parallelizing.
_collision_notes.P3.1+P3.2+P3.3: Sequential mandatory; same chat or strict handoff.
_collision_notes.P4+P6+P8+P9 after P3.3: Disjoint worktrees, fully parallelizable. With 6 chats and S0 + P3.3 already merged, you can run P4, P5, P6, P7, P8, P9 simultaneously.
